notes.Null_Human_Evidence: Null outcomes occur inside reviews but no standalone independently labelled null-RCT Gold source.
notes.Conflicting_Evidence: Case 021 is the first active GoldCase whose resolved Ground Truth itself contains two applicable, equally ranked SYSTEMATIC_REVIEW references with opposing verdicts and resolves to REFERENCE_CONFLICT. Case 005 separately documents a later conflicting review but contains only one governing applicable reference.
notes.Missing_Evidence: Cases 005 and 022 cover scientific insufficiency (AssertionState.INSUFFICIENT), not retrieval failure. Case 022 additionally tests that the higher-ranked systematic review governs over a positive EMA/HMPC source.
notes.Source_Unavailable: Supported by End-to-End framework/tests but not yet represented by a real locked corpus source-unavailable case.
notes.RCT: RCTs appear inside systematic reviews but are not independently curated GoldSourceExpectations; current precedence does not permit RCT as governing INDICATION_EVIDENCE source.
notes.Observational_Studies: No independently curated observational Gold source.
notes.WHO: Case 019 is the first active WHO_MONOGRAPH governing source (WHO Monographs Vol.1, Radix Ginseng).
notes.ESCOP: Case 020 is the first active ESCOP_MONOGRAPH governing source (ESCOP 2021 Echinaceae purpureae herba). Only claims visible on the official public summary are curated.
notes.Cross_rank_precedence: Case 022 is the first active GoldCase with two applicable references of different INDICATION_EVIDENCE ranks; SYSTEMATIC_REVIEW is selected over a newer EMA_HMPC monograph.
